subject: Arborsight onboarding — deployment steward & kickoff windows
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Arborsight onboarding — deployment steward & kickoff windows

Hi team,

Passing along the Arborsight handoff — closing call was last week and legal has signed SOW v3 (attached). Quick context: Arborsight is a mid-market analytics platform; they bought a 12-month Dedicated plan with an initial 3-month pilot (prod traffic scoped to 10k monthly API calls, peak concurrency ~45). Key integrations: SAML SSO, VPC peering to their AWS account, and an initial data sync from their reporting DB for prompt enrichment. Go-live target range is Oct 25–29 (customer prefers the 26th).

What I need from CS:
- Primary deployment steward assigned (single point for kickoff and handoffs)
- Confirmation of pre-kickoff tasks ownerable in the next 7 business days (network checklist, test account provisioning, staging model pin)
- Provisional kickoff slot proposals (preferably Oct 20–23 for a pre-kickoff tech check, then final kickoff w/customer Oct 26)

Internal notes / negotiation heads-up: procurement indicated they will request a PO with 60-day payment terms; they also asked about a one-time onboarding credit (we offered to surface to finance for approval). The customer will need PKI cert exchange for VPC peering; Evan (IT lead) is copied below.

Attachments: Arborsight_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW, milestones, acceptance criteria), network_checklist.xlsx (network prerequisites), kickoff_agenda_draft.docx (blank draft agenda).

Marcus — can you be primary steward? Tessa — would you take secondary (post-go-live adoption touchpoint)? If either of you see any red flags in the SOW (timeline, resourcing), call them out here and I’ll loop AE / Legal.

Thanks —
Olga
Olga Petrov | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Arborsight onboarding — deployment steward & kickoff windows

Thanks Olga — happy to take primary steward. Quick read on SOW looks sane but a few follow-ups before we lock dates:

1) Staging environment: do we have a pre-provisioned staging cluster for them or do we need to spin one under Dedicated capacity? If it’s a fresh cluster, lead time is ~3 business days.
2) Data volume: the SOW lists "initial sync ~150GB" — confirm whether that’s compressed or raw (impacts time-to-sync and migration window).
3) Ops on-call: recommend we reserve a 2-hr ops overlap window during go-live and have the runtime engineer (I’ll nominate Sam) on standby.

Provisional plan:
- Sep 21: internal tech pre-check (network checklist complete + staging verified)
- Oct 6: dry-run with customer in staging (walk through auth, small sample sync)
- Oct 26: production kickoff and acceptance window starts

I’ll take ownership of the network checklist (will ping Evan directly for their firewall/peering info). Tessa — if you share a few times you’re blocked out, I’ll propose calendar invites.

Marcus
Marcus Lin | Customer Success Manager
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Arborsight onboarding — deployment steward & kickoff windows

Thanks — I can be secondary steward and will take ownership of adoption milestones (30/60/90 day health checks, model quality monitoring configuration). A couple of items I want noted:

- We should lock a time for "expectations & escalation" in the kickoff agenda so the customer understands SLA and fallback policies if we hit quota/contention.
- I'll prepare a draft kickoff agenda and upload to Drive (link below). Please review and add any items you want covered in the pre-check.

Suggested pre-check week: Sep 20–23 (I’m flexible mornings PST).

Drive draft: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/0Bxy-arborsight-onboarding/kickoff_agenda_draft

Tessa Morgan | Senior Customer Success Manager
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai

From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@arborsight.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@arborsight.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Arborsight onboarding — deployment steward & kickoff windows

Hi Olga / Marcus / Tessa —

Thanks for the clear plan. Oct 26 works for our team for production kickoff; Sep 21 pre-check is fine too. A few items from our side:

- PO# PO-884321 is in flight; procurement expects the invoice after go-live acceptance.
- Evan — can you share the list of outbound ports and the public CIDR we should expect for peering? Also we may need a short certificate exchange window — our infra team prefers Oct 19 for cert handoff.
- Small ask: would Redwood consider a one-time $5k onboarding credit applied to the first invoice? We had that discussed during negotiation.

I’ve attached a short network summary from our infra team (network_checklist.xlsx). Let us know any missing info.

Best,
Lara Chen
Director of Partnerships | Arborsight
lara.chen@arborsight.com | +1 617-555-0899
